flagged.evidence: Step 1.1 concludes “so their images are disjoint” from disjoint endpoint sets. In S^1×I, two smooth graph arcs with flat endpoint collars can join 0 to 1/2 and 1/2 to 0: their endpoint sets are disjoint on both boundary faces, but the arcs cross in the interior. Their union need not be embedded, so [F1] does not license the asserted union.

The statement asserts a monoid under disjoint union for every k≥0. Take M to be a point and k=0. Its closed codimension-zero submanifolds are only ∅ and M; [M] is not framed cobordant to ∅, since that would require a compact 1-manifold with a one-point boundary, contrary to the opened boundary-parity lemma. Thus [M] has no two disjoint representatives whose union defines [M]+[M].
